notes.title: Big Update: Achievement is Here!🐾✨
notes.notes:
Attention, dear guardians!

The brand-new Achievement has officially arrived! Whether you're braving the Survival Mode or embarking on the Challenge Mode, there’s now a whole bunch of fun tasks waiting for you to complete! 🎮

We’ve designed 58 exciting achievements to challenge players in all aspects, including:
•	Card Collection: From quantity to types to rarity!
•	Combat Mastery: Prove your strength and strategies in battle!
•	Survival Skills: Stay alive in the harshest conditions!
•	Growth Management: Expand and strengthen your cat homeland!
•	Special Abilities: Unique and rewarding challenges for the true masters!
•	Completionist Goals: Show the world you're the ultimate cat defender!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/f5bdababa78be6254f3b46b4050844fc4a26206f.png


Examples of achievements:
•	Survival Mode: Collect a certain number of cats – " Cat Boom 🐾", " A Full Cat Clan 🐾", " The Purr-fect Family 🐾"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/3c91ec237a8f8c82f3af4133c3d2917184a58f3f.jpg

•	Challenge Mode: Combat Mastery– " Bee Bane 🛡️", " Bee Slayer ːsteammockingː",

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/0d470ce081d6bf18277b0fafad48edf6196984b8.jpg

ːsteamhappyːAnd there are a lot more - waiting for your exploration!


Pro Tip:
If you’ve already completed the game, don’t forget to jump back in and try again!  ːsteamhappyː
Some achievements may require replaying to trigger, so gear up and start your journey toward becoming the ultimate achievement hunter! 🏆


________________________________________

Our Promise as a Two-Person Indie Dev Team:

We are committed to constantly updating, adding new content, and optimizing the game. 
Our goal is to be long-term creators who provide you with tons of value-packed and enjoyable gameplay! 
This update is designed to add even more fun to your Cat Guardian journey. 
Don’t forget to check out the achievement interface and
share with us how many trophies you’ve unlocked in Discussion! 


Our Wish for You
May your Cat Army grow strong, your achievements shine bright, and your pockets overflow with good fortune in 2025! 🙌🐾


Stay Tuned!

notes.title: Major Update: A Friendlier New Player Experience 🐾✨
notes.notes:
Dear Guardians,

We are excited to announce that a major update for Cat Guardians is now officially live!

Whether you’re a new player just starting your adventure or a seasoned defender of the Meowks Planet, this update is designed to bring you a smoother and more exhilarating gameplay experience! 🎉
Here are the full details of the update:


🐾 Update Highlights: Major New Player Guidance Upgrades!
🎮Two Modes Optimized: Challenge & Survival, Friendlier and Easier to Pick Up!

     Survival Mode

 Added a detailed tutorial for the first 5 days, with step-by-step guidance to help you quickly understand the core mechanics of survival gameplay.
 Introduced helpful tips and increased resource support to ensure a stress-free start for new players. No need to worry—everything is explained, and you'll be fully equipped to defend your cat homeland!


In Survival Mode, we’ve introduced a thoughtful tutorial designed to make it much easier for new players to get started! 
With the addition of tutorial prompts and extra resource support, you’ll now enjoy a safer and more structured beginning to your journey!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/1b25d97f8cf9318cfe44f3d3ed29f6e5ebbf6b10.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/7d46bb944105185f5f213033a0618d9d8abe6f96.jpg



     Challenge Mode

 Improved guidance with clearer, more straightforward prompts to help new players quickly grasp cards and battle strategies.
 Added clear objective indicators, making your adventure smoother and more rewarding!


To help players get started with Challenge Mode more quickly, we’ve optimized the level objective indicators. 
Now, it’s easier than ever to understand how to build your deck and achieve your goals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/ad4022258e68f1142b56f3f5b37152970bf18629.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/c45bec5a1aca4c2c5a48c081a87467b177d7c3bc.jpg




⚔️Difficulty Curve Adjustments: Immersive Battle Experience!

 We’ve fine-tuned the difficulty curve for both Survival and Challenge modes, ensuring that every level feels exhilarating—challenging yet fun.
 Experience smoother battle pacing and endless possibilities for card strategy, fully immersing yourself in the world of Cat Guardian!


We’ve made comprehensive adjustments to the difficulty curve! Now, you’ll enjoy a smoother combat flow while indulging in the immersive thrill of strategic battles.




🛠️ Fixes & Improvements

[olist]
 Fixed a series of bugs related to the Tree of Hope.
 Resolved the infinite building duplication bug.
 Fixed the quick interaction issue with cat cards.
 Addressed the bug affecting zombie damage values caused by the Toxic Bomb series.
 Fixed the issue where cat cards would randomly disappear in Challenge Mode.
 Corrected the pollution index display error.
 Fixed the issue where the laboratory could not generate Cat Elixir.
 Resolved the planting bug during extreme heat conditions.
 Fixed a series of cat card-related bugs.
 Resolved the population counter bug.
 Fixed several save/load bugs, optimized loading logic, and improved loading speeds.
 Adjusted the effect of blizzards on weapon card attack power to 50%.
 Added hover tooltips for the four shop buttons to display their type names.
 Adjusted material prices in the shop.
 Modified the explosion radius of self-destructing zombies.
[/olist]

With these fixes and improvements, your gameplay will be smoother, more balanced, and free of some pesky issues! 🎉



❤️Finally, Thank You!
We sincerely thank every one of you for your support and feedback—
it’s your input that drives us to continuously improve the game! 
If you enjoy this update, feel free to leave a comment or share your thoughts in the community. 
And of course, if you have more suggestions, we’re always here to listen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45056649/42f24209cb5461a10ef1ea03f686f503951847c3.png


The newly optimized Cat Guardian is ready for you! 
Whether it’s the new tutorials or the smooth battle experience, everything is waiting for you to explore. 

Update your game now and join the all-new adventure in Cat Guardians! 🐾💖

—Your Meowks Planet needs you!



Good luck, Guardian!
The Cat Guardian Dev Team

notes.title: Cat Guardian Launches FREE Demo Version: 1.5 Hours of Free Content Available Now
notes.notes:
Dear Players, 

The exciting moment is finally here! ːsteamhappyː

We are thrilled to announce that the FREE demo version of Cat Guardian is now live! 

Starting today, you can enjoy a preview of our carefully crafted game content and experience the thrills of both “Challenge Mode” and “Survival Mode” for a total of  1.5 hours of gameplay. 

In this demo, you’ll get to play 10 days of “Challenge Mode” and 10 days of “Survival Mode.” 

This is just a slice of the full game, which offers around 10 hours of content. The current demo only represents 15% of the entire game. 
We recommend starting with “Challenge Mode” to get familiar with the game mechanics before diving into “Survival Mode” for a more immersive experience.
